subject: bootstrap: unify system tables creation through versionedBootstrapSchemas to avoid error when we add more system tables (#66056)
summary: Reviewed `pkg/session/bootstrap.go` changes: classic bootstrap now creates mysql system tables by iterating `versionedBootstrapSchemas` (same source used by next-gen `bootstrapSchemas`), removing the separate `tablesInSystemDatabase` list and the brittle slice-count constant. Current behavior is effectively unchanged at this commit (still one base schema entry with the same 52 system tables); next-gen version-gated meta-kv creation logic remains the same.
